indeterminate.description:
Unknown-duration mode. When set, no completed fraction or current value is
exposed. Its motion is declared only when reduced motion is not requested.
When to use: show ongoing work whose duration or total cannot be measured.
When NOT to use: do not use for known fractions; use `value` and `max`.

label.description:
Accessible name applied to the internal progressbar. Always set this to
what is progressing, such as "Uploading report.pdf". Without it the
element renders but exposes no accessible name, so the catalog contract
requires it.
When NOT to use: do not use a generic label such as "Loading" when the
task can be named more specifically.

max.description:
Total amount. Non-finite, zero or negative values normalize to `100` for
presentation and ARIA.
When to use: set when a determinate task's total is not 100.
When NOT to use: omit for conventional percentage-style progress.

shape.description:
Structural presentation. Use `linear` in page flows and lists; use
`circular` in compact or centered placements. Unknown values render linear.
When NOT to use: do not use shape to encode semantic status or task intent.

--ki-motion-duration-medium-2.description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium2 (300ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms).

--ki-progress-circular-size.description: dimension used by the progress component for circular size.

--ki-progress-circular-track-width.description: dimension used by the progress component for circular track width.

--ki-progress-indeterminate-duration.description: duration used by the progress component for progress indeterminate duration.

--ki-progress-indicator-color.description: MarsUI fills components with the med-em (500) tone of the ramp (marsui-design-dna.md §1; specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §§2.1-2.4 delta 500-vs-high-em): progress indicator uses surface.primary-med-em.

--ki-progress-linear-radius.description: dimension used by the progress component for linear radius.

--ki-progress-linear-thickness.description: dimension used by the progress component for linear thickness.

--ki-progress-track-color.description: color used by the progress component for track color.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description:
A token-styled, non-interactive progress indicator for known or unknown
duration work.

indicator.description:
The advancing fill or arc: indicator ink and indeterminate
animation.

track.description: The full channel or ring: track ink and radius/stroke geometry.
